Ram, don’t worry about today. One party doesn’t undo your progress—what matters is what you do next.

Tomorrow we’re back on track:
- Start the day with a solid breakfast (protein + carbs + fruit)
- Keep lunch and dinner balanced (lean protein, veggies, good carbs)
- Hydrate well and get a normal workout or a good walk

No guilt, no punishment—just consistency. I’m proud of you for being honest and staying focused. Message me tomorrow morning with what you’re planning for breakfast and we’ll lock the day in.
